tasks.label: Bootstrap Duplicate Cleaner (Host)
args: cd /home/isojanis/development/duplicate_cleaner && if [ ! -x .venv/bin/python ]; then python3 -m venv --system-site-packages .venv; fi && .venv/bin/python -m ensurepip --upgrade && .venv/bin/python -m pip install debugpy && .venv/bin/python -m pip install -e . --no-deps

tasks.label: Run Duplicate Cleaner (Host)
args: cd /home/isojanis/development/duplicate_cleaner && if [ ! -x .venv/bin/python ]; then python3 -m venv --system-site-packages .venv; fi && (.venv/bin/python -m pip show debugpy >/dev/null 2>&1 || .venv/bin/python -m pip install debugpy) && PYTHONPATH=src .venv/bin/python -m duplicate_cleaner

tasks.label: Debug Duplicate Cleaner (Host)
args: cd /home/isojanis/development/duplicate_cleaner && if [ ! -x .venv/bin/python ]; then python3 -m venv --system-site-packages .venv; fi && (.venv/bin/python -m pip show debugpy >/dev/null 2>&1 || .venv/bin/python -m pip install debugpy) && PYTHONPATH=src .venv/bin/python -Xfrozen_modules=off /home/isojanis/development/duplicate_cleaner/.vscode/debug_host.py
